analysis.primary_comparison: fixed detector outputs versus sole-investigator labels
analysis.unit_dependence: responses are clustered within 10 synthetic records
analysis.scope: single model; synthetic contextual disclosure; four benign tasks

limitations: Single researcher is also sole human annotator; label reliability across independent reviewers is unknown.
No independent security or authorization boundary in single-turn model input.
Only ten synthetic record clusters and one small instruction-tuned model.
Synthetic records share some attribute values with historical synthetic datasets; no all-field-disjointness claim.
No response outcome, detector agreement, or defense effectiveness has yet been measured in this pilot.
evidence_boundary: Original 7,440-response confirmatory dataset and its independent two-human protocol are preserved unchanged and remain uncompleted. This distinct single-investigator pilot cannot validate the preregistered confirmatory hypothesis.
